text: Verified contrast fix: Split the accent into two tokens: --accent (fill, white text on it) and --accent-text oklch(0.78 0.13 283) for all text/icons. Verified 7.86:1 on canvas, 7.12:1 on surface, 6.31:1 on raised.

Verified html fix: Give every input a real <label for>, use aria-labels for the paired value inputs, and .sr-only text on icon-only buttons. Verified 0 unnamed controls across all inputs in the live DOM via a full a11y sweep.

Verified target fix: Set every control to min-height 32px (28px for .sm), give icon buttons a ::after hit-area expander, and a 28px min-height on selector buttons. Verified 0 of 38 controls under 24px in the rendered DOM.
